04 · SALES & PROFITABILITY ANALYTICS
Adventure Works Sales Dashboard

A Power BI dashboard analyzing sales performance, profitability, product categories, resellers, salespersons, and regional performance for Adventure Works. Bikes emerged as the dominant revenue category (led by the Mountain-200 series), Warehouse and Value-Added Reseller channels drove most sales, and North America and Europe were the strongest regions — while margins stayed thin, pointing to cost-optimization opportunities.
